quests.title: Something Strange
quests.text: It's been a while! I've got an interesting bit of news. Want to hear it? They say the monsters have grown more aggressive lately, and the dungeons feel eerier than usual. The sky has also turned a strange color, leading some to wonder if the witches are up to something. If you have some time, could you check out the Forgotten Castle, deal with the monsters there, and see if you notice anything suspicious?

quests.title: Something Wicked
quests.text: I looked into those dolls, and it turns out witches do use them in their rituals. Not for anything good, of course. But the witches who practiced dark magic disappeared long ago because of those judges... So where could these dolls be coming from? I've heard rumors of similar ones in other dungeons as well. Could you deal with the monsters there and see if they're carrying the same dolls?

quests.title: Before It Gets Worse
quests.text: I can't shake the feeling that someone has wicked intentions behind all this. Anyway, if we leave things as they are, those dreadful judges might show up again. Then all the good witches who light the flame on my head will go into hiding. And if that happens, you might not get to see this handsome face next year! We can't have that. Bring me those wretched dolls. Let's gather them all before this gets any worse!

quests.title: Treasure Hunt
quests.text: A festival wouldn’t be complete without a treasure hunt. I’ve hidden my small, adorable treasures all over the place. They make a very clear sound, so they won’t be too hard to find. Just bring me ten. Easy enough, right?

quests.title: Rest for the Dead
quests.text: I’m fair to everyone. But festivals are for the living. The dead still shambling around don’t suit this happy season. Would you take care of them for me?

quests.title: Winter’s Chaos
quests.text: I like those who take action, no matter what. A life spent standing still is boring. So this time, why don’t you do what you enjoy? Wreck every dungeon you can, and make it back alive.

quests.title: Krampus’ Small Gift
quests.text: Only those who are truly enjoying this winter’s festival can claim my Golden Bell. Bring me one, and I’ll give you a small gift in return.

quests.title: Krampus’ Decent Gift
quests.text: Only those who are truly enjoying this winter’s festival can claim my Golden Bell. Five of them means you did more than just watch, so I’ll have a decent reward ready for you.

quests.title: Krampus’ Special Gift
quests.text: Only those who are truly enjoying this winter’s festival can claim my Golden Bell. Fifteen of them means you’ve completely taken over the festival, so you can expect something special.

quests.title: Adventurer’s Essentials
quests.text: Greetings, adventurer. We need armor for the fellow adventurers helping search for my missing daughter. Any type will do. We'd greatly appreciate it if you could bring us some.

quests.title: Time to Heal
quests.text: Dungeons have long been places of both promise and peril. It reminds me of how much my daughter always fancied the statues in those forsaken places. I have searched there many times and found little, but perhaps you might discover something new.

quests.title: Campfire Tales
quests.text: Good to see you again. Those old campsites in the Ruins were once places of respite for us. Travelers and trappers alike knew them well. Search around them for any clues that might shed light on my daughter’s whereabouts.

quests.title: Oaken Up
quests.text: I heard you can find all sorts of things inside Oak Chests scattered throughout the dungeons... Would you mind opening a few for me?

quests.title: Frosty Encounters
quests.text: The Frost Mountain is crawling with angry little Kobolds and animated Skeletons! If you can help clear the place up I might have something for you... also... bring back proof of your work.

quests.title: Into The Abyss
quests.text: There’s word of an Ice Abyss hidden deep within the depths of The Frost Mountain... Frost Sentinels are said to be a common sight down there... take a look for me, will ya?

quests.title: Whispers in the Ruins
quests.text: The last place my daughter went was the Ruins. After all word of her was lost, I searched that place time and again but found nothing. Now I only hope to find even the smallest trace of her, even if it is found among the monsters that roam the Ruins.

quests.title: Dukes of The Dead
quests.text: Death’s lieutenants have corrupted every corner of The Forgotten Castle. Eliminating that monster will deal a devastating blow to their evil deeds. This is just the beginning of cleansing our land.

quests.title: Bane of the Rulers
quests.text: You’ve proven yourself worthy of a task I once deemed unspeakable. Powerful beings who rule the Crypts have revealed themselves once more. We must act before their influence grows any stronger.

quests.title: Echoes of Memory
quests.text: Not long ago, a new band of adventurers passed through here. Did you happen to see them? Strangely enough, they were made up just like the group my daughter once traveled with... It brought back memories I hadn’t touched in years. I’d like to offer them a small kindness, if I may. They’re young still, and it shows in the state of their armor. If you could help me gather some gear and fabric, I would see it properly repaid.

quests.title: Faith and Worry
quests.text: The skeletons in the Forgotten Castle are always a trouble. Especially for the inexperienced, who often panic at their strange, jerking movements and end up badly hurt. I ask that you clear out some of those creatures, for the sake of the ones who have only just begun their journey. But even for someone as seasoned as you, carelessness can be dangerous. Please, adventurer... do not let yourself be harmed.

quests.title: The Shadow of the Dream
quests.text: Last night, I had a dreadful dream. My daughter was crying out from deep within the Inferno. I was frozen in place, unable to move a single step, and all I could do was watch as she suffered in the distance. Adventurer, will you go to the Inferno on my behalf? There is something there, I am certain of it. Please, find it. Please, help put an end to my daughter's tears.

quests.title: Ominous Movements
quests.text: The goblins have taken to raiding the merchant caravans passing through these parts, and even the materials I purchased with what little coin I had have vanished in one of their attacks. I can't make sense of what’s driving them, nor do I have the strength to fight back myself, but we can't simply let this go. If you find any crates in their cave, break them. Smash every last one you see. They must be made to answer for what they've done.

quests.title: Strange Kinship
quests.text: The most dangerous creatures in the goblin cave are the cyclops and the troll. Folks have long hoped the two would turn on each other, but strangely enough, some sort of bond seems to have formed between them. Friendship between monsters... I can't understand it, and truth be told, I’d rather not. Take them both down, and bring back whatever spoils you find.

quests.title: Plundering the Plunder
quests.text: Ever since you shattered all the crates in their cave, the goblins have begun hoarding their loot in golden chests, or so I’ve heard. Their senseless raids haven’t stopped either. Adventurer, this time I ask you to target the golden chests. Take as many as you can.

quests.title: Materials for Truth
quests.text: The alchemist says... that to confirm whether those remains are truly my daughter, a certain material is required. I do not wish to know, and yet... the thought that I must will not leave me. But... I cannot bring myself to take that step. Would you gather what is needed in my stead?

quests.title: Revealed Truth
quests.text: The alchemist says the same trace found on her belongings was present in the remains as well. Then... it is likely that they truly are my daughter’s... I must know what did this to her. There is something needed to uncover the truth. I ask this of you.

quests.title: For Her
quests.text: The alchemist has named the most likely culprit. Hunters that roam the deep of the Inferno. Creatures driven by madness, preying on both man and their own kind without distinction. ...Was my daughter taken as their prey as well... Adventurer, find them and put an end to them.

quests.title: The Land in Flames
quests.text: Through our misguided choices, the calamity of fire that lay dormant, Ignir, has awakened. I barely managed to escape that place, but many of my kin are still held there, bound by his control. To save them, I will need your help, Adventurer. But before I ask you to take on such danger, I must be certain that this is something you can endure.

quests.title: Traces of the Scattered
quests.text: When I fled my homeland, there were companions who escaped alongside me. But in the chaos of our flight, we were scattered apart. Could you find out what became of them? My homeland is a place of intense heat, so making use of the Dwarven Shrines should help.

quests.title: Those Bound in Fire
quests.text: Could you check on the condition of my kin? Ignir slowly eroded our minds, until he finally seized our will and forced us to labor for him alone. But if there is even one who still retains their senses, I do not wish to abandon them. Even if conflict arises in the process, it may simply be unavoidable.

quests.title: Beasts in the Flames
quests.text: Ignir has twisted not only my kin, but also the beasts of that land. They were once animals we raised, but now they wander through the flames, stripped of reason and driven to rage. If left unchecked, they will become a greater threat. Put them down and bring back what remains as proof.

quests.title: Unbelievable News
quests.text: Those who recently returned from my homeland say they found the bodies of our kin there. But when I escaped that place, they were still alive, though under control. I do not know what happened in the time between. Adventurer, please examine the condition of the fallen and report back to me.

quests.title: Servant of Fire
quests.text: My kin who have been enthralled continue to dig without rest. As a result, the lava fields have spread, and a lava golem has emerged. That golem is, for all intents and purposes, a thrall of Ignir. As Ignir’s influence grows, the golem’s strength will grow with it. We must bring that creature down before it is too late.

quests.title: To find an opening
quests.text: Before we confront Ignir, it would be wise to assess his current state. Please investigate the area around the great forge. Observe the condition of the flames and the flow of the lava, then report back. As Ignir is devoting his strength to expanding his control, he cannot be maintaining perfect command over everything. We must find that opening.

quests.title: Final Preparations
quests.text: Fire spirits and elementals are beings that aid Ignir in restoring his strength. They act as conduits, gathering the power of fire and delivering it to him. If left alone, the scattered power will quickly come together again. To slow that process, even if only a little, we must eliminate them.

quests.title: The Incomplete Colossus
quests.text: According to legend, a fully awakened Ignir is a being made solely of living lava. But due to the seal breaking incompletely, he now bears the form of a colossus, solid stone entwined with molten fire. We must stop him before he regains his true form. Adventurer, please put an end to him.

quests.title: For a Sturdy Hull
quests.text: Well met, adventurer. Might I ask for your aid in repairing this old ship? With a bit of work, she could sail again as a proper merchant vessel. Should you choose to help, you’ll be fairly rewarded. For now, I’ll need stout timber, strong enough to hold against the sea’s fury.

quests.title: The Cloth That Wraps the Wind
quests.text: I bought this ship with the coin I earned working as a merchant navigator. I would have liked a better vessel, but this is what I could afford. Sometimes, you simply make do with what you have. Now I need a new sail. If the fabric is weak, it won’t catch the wind properly. Please bring me sturdy cloth and a set of sewing tools.

quests.title: The Knot That Binds All
quests.chapter: The Cloth That Wraps the Wind
quests.text: Once you’ve been aboard a ship, you’ll come to see just how many ropes are used throughout. They wear down quickly, and constant maintenance is a part of life at sea. Bring me several ropes. It’s all right if some are worn. I can trim away the bad sections and salvage the rest. As long as the critical lines are secured, we’ll be ready to depart.

quests.title: Shadow of the Past
quests.text: The pirates roaming the Ship Graveyard belong to the infamous Black Despair crew. They’ve plundered countless vessels and left a trail of death behind them. They're the reason I walked away from my life as a merchant navigator. I cannot forgive them. Adventurer, I ask you to see that they are dealt with.

quests.title: Coffins Beneath the Waves
quests.text: Have you seen the large, shell-like structures scattered across the Ship Graveyard? Among sailors, they’re known as mermaid coffins, though no one truly knows what lies within. My brother once studied them. It doesn’t matter much anymore, but still... I’d like to know the truth, if only for his sake. Please, take a look inside one of those coffins.

quests.title: Trial of Worth
quests.text: Each of us has our strengths. I know how to command a ship, but I'm no fighter. That is why I’ve been searching for someone who could stand in my place, someone skilled in both battle and survival. Someone who could help me see my revenge through. Adventurer, will you show me what you’re capable of?

quests.title: Brawler of the Sea
quests.text: The Tidewalkers are a troublesome foe. Once they spot an enemy, they attack without hesitation, no matter the circumstance. They're especially aggressive when accompanied by one of their shamans, so caution is advised. A scouting party I sent out recently has run into serious trouble because of them. I could use your help. Subdue them, if you can.

quests.title: Pieces of a Broken Dream
quests.text: During the last search, we were fortunate enough to recover a portion of the map I’ve been looking for. But it isn’t enough. We need the remaining pieces. With both the monsters and the pirates still prowling that place, continuing the search is proving too difficult. Adventurer, would you help me recover the rest of the map? I’m asking for your help.

quests.title: Where the Map Points
quests.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask. While examining my brother’s map, I found a marked location deeper within the Ship Graveyard. It’s labeled for investigation, though I don’t know what he hoped to find there. Could you look into it for me? If anything stands out, please let me know.

quests.title: An Unforgotten Memory
quests.text: When my ship was taken by pirates... I was lucky to survive, but the others weren’t. Most were thrown into the sea, and that was the last I saw of them. The waters near the Blue Maelstrom are full of man-eating fish. Adventurer, please deal with them. And if you find any items that might have belonged to sailors, bring them to me. I want to know if they were people I once knew.

quests.title: A Wish Etched in Ink
quests.text: While reading through my crewmate’s journal, I found something interesting. It speaks of glowing pearls and unusually shaped coral near the Blue Maelstrom. It seems he truly wished to see them with his own eyes. Adventurer, would you help me find them? I’d like to fulfill his wish, even if it’s a little late.

quests.title: The Path Beyond the Map
quests.text: My brother’s research notes speak of a great river that once existed and a guardian said to dwell within it. Most of it is speculation, but the description of the guardian is hard to ignore. A beast with massive jaws, a vertical eye, and thick, leathery skin... It might be connected to the Crocodilian. Hunt them down and bring me one of their eyes. There’s something I need to confirm.

quests.title: The Pirate's Refuge
quests.text: We’ve scouted much of the Ship Graveyard, but the area where the pirates gather is beyond what our search parties can handle. Adventurer, I need you to investigate the places they frequent. We must know what kind of weapons they’re hiding and whether they’re preparing for something. They’re not to be underestimated, so be careful.

quests.title: The Price of Loyalty
quests.text: The Black Despair pirates are blindly loyal to their captain. They’ve long claimed dominion over these seas, plundering and burning countless ships. Now it’s time they were repaid in kind.

quests.title: Despair’s End
quests.text: There isn’t a sailor alive who hasn’t heard of Captain Bladehand. That wretched pirate has long been a scar buried deep within me. Ever since the day I survived his attack, I’ve waited for the chance to take revenge. Now, everything is in place. Adventurer, I ask you to end him.

quests.title: A Crimson Holiday
quests.text: Ho ho ho! Normally, it's coal for the naughty, but you, my friend, have a different approach! The realm's naughty seem to need a touch of holiday spirit. A bit of a tussle, a friendly battle perhaps will change their act and get them on my good list!

quests.title: Jolly Survivor
quests.text: Next up, we've got a real test of endurance. The dungeons around here are no joke, but I bet they're no match for your festive spirit. How about a merry jaunt through them?

quests.title: Gingerbread Stocking
quests.text: Now, for a bit of holiday fun! I'm running short on gingerbread cookies – essential for the festive season you know. How about a merry scavenger hunt to gather some up? They're scattered all around, just waiting to be found!

quests.title: Awoken Without a Name
quests.text: I remember not who I am... what deeds I once performed... nor even the reason for my death... There is but one thing I recall... that I am searching for something... That yearning alone stirred me from my slumber... Perhaps, if the coffins within the catacombs were opened... some trace may yet remain... Adventurer... would you help me recover the memories I have lost...?

quests.title: Where the Dead Whisper
quests.text: Adventurer... I ask thee to journey to the place where others like me have begun to stir... Seek out any among them who, like myself, may have recovered fragments of their memory... If such a one exists, you may be able to speak with them... and perhaps then I shall learn what it is I am truly seeking...

quests.title: What I Truly Desired
quests.text: ...What is it that I so desperately longed for... Was it treasure... or jewels... such things as these... Could it be that mere filthy greed... was what led so many to their deaths by my hand... Gods, let it not be so... Adventurer... bring me the gems... If I see them with my own eyes, perhaps I shall know the truth...

quests.title: The Scroll That Should Not Be
quests.text: At last, I remember... What I seek is a scroll... one that holds knowledge most dangerous... It was used to draw out the essence of darkness... using people... leading them, in the end, to death... That scroll is unlike any other... it has not faded, nor has it decayed... and it still lies somewhere within the castle... Adventurer, I beg you... please, find it for me...

quests.title: Keeping It Together
quests.text: It's been a while, Adventurer. Every time we cross blades, my companions end up scattered throughout the dungeon. It's hard to believe it's been three years of the same thing. If you still have even a shred of pity left for us, would you bring me a few usable bones and an intact skull? It's rather difficult to maintain one's dignity when one is scattered into pieces.

quests.title: Kind Regards
quests.text: Come to think of it, few lives are as simple as ours. Adventurers arrive, we fight, we fall, then we wait again. I've lost count of how many years it's been... Yet in the end, I can't deny that facing you is the greatest joy we have. Since we're on the subject, do give my companions in the other dungeons my regards.

quests.title: Bone Appétit
quests.text: As the years pass, our bones gradually wear away. But gold teeth never lose their shine. Those with plenty of them are the envy of our kind. Since we're on the subject, would you bring me a few gold teeth and some moldy bread? I'd like to enjoy a proper delicacy for the first time in a while.

quests.title: The Squire’s Request
quests.text: Hello, adventurer. Um... could I ask you for a small favor? I'm helping out adventurers here for now, but it's always been my dream to go on a real adventure myself someday. My uncle, the Tavern Master, keeps saying it's too soon and won't let me go. But I just know I could do well, if I had some decent gear. If you could find me a few pieces... would you, maybe? Please?

quests.title: The Squire’s Curiosity
quests.text: I know it's just a Ruins now, but it used to be a grand castle, didn't it? It's become a lair for monsters these days... but I've heard that many of the old statues are still standing, hidden throughout the place. I was wondering... could you look for them in my stead? I'm not quite ready to go there myself, not yet. Please... would you do that for me?

quests.title: The Squire’s Compassion
quests.text: They say the Forgotten Castle is haunted by skeletons that walk on their own. What kind of terrible curse could force them to rise, even in death, never knowing rest? Whenever I talk like this, people tell me not to dwell on such things... but I can't help it. I think it's all so very sad. Please, adventurer, help those poor souls find peace.

quests.title: The Squire’s Failure
quests.text: I went to the Forgotten Castle on my own not long ago... but I barely made it past the entrance before some beast started chasing me. I ran for my life and somehow got away, but I lost my weapon and my armor’s all torn to bits. Becoming an adventurer... it’s not quite how I imagined. I’d go back and try again, but I don’t have anything to wear or wield anymore. Adventurer, could you help me find new gear? Something a little better this time... please?

quests.title: The Squire’s Daydream
quests.text: Adventurer, have you ever been to Frost Mountain? Just imagining a place where it's always winter feels like something out of a dream. Especially the ice caves. I'm sure they're filled with crystal-clear ice, glittering like gemstones. And the ceiling must be lined with huge icicles, hanging down like frozen spears. It must be such a breathtaking sight! If you ever go there, would you tell me what it was like? If anything stands out, something truly magical, please promise you'll share it with me!

quests.title: The Squire’s Reality
quests.text: Adventurer... the skeletons were nothing like I imagined. I thought I would feel sorry for them, but I didn’t. They were terrifying. I only saw them from afar, but I was so scared I couldn’t even move. And the ones in Frost Mountain were even worse. Their bones were all frozen blue, like they had been trapped in ice for ages. It was awful. Please, adventurer, can you take care of them? I don’t think I’ll be able to sleep until they're gone.

quests.title: The Squire’s Sorrow
quests.text: The Frost Mountain adventure was a complete disaster. I barely made it out alive, and only thanks to the companions who were with me. I lost all my gear too... the ones you worked so hard to find for me. I'm such a fool... You don’t have to say anything to comfort me. My uncle was right. Maybe someone like me just isn’t meant to be an adventurer... What? You want to help me get new equipment again? No, please, don’t trouble yourself because of me. Adventurer? Adventurer, wait!

quests.title: The Squire’s Hesitation
quests.text: This time, I don't want to be a burden to anyone, so I'm looking for a place I can explore on my own. I heard the Goblin Caves aren't too difficult for a beginner adventurer. What do you think? Still, the thought of going alone is a bit scary... If you don’t mind, could you check the caves out first? Just to see if there are any safe spots or places to hide, even just a little. Hehe... thank you.

quests.title: For the Squire
quests.text: Well... I did make it as far as the cave entrance, but... there were a lot more goblins than I expected. With that many, I don't think I could handle even one on my own. And if they surround me, I’d be in real trouble. Adventurer, would you be willing to take care of some of the goblins for me? I think I’d find the courage to try again if I knew it was a little safer.

quests.title: Marks of Malice
quests.text: I’ve had an influx of patients recently—so I need more supplies, stat. Many of them have those marks, carved deep into their skin. Some of the cuts are precise, almost surgical, while others look like they were made by a less experienced hand. There’s something about these wounds that’s disturbing.

quests.title: In the Name of Progress
quests.text: I am a physician, but there are things in this world that cannot be treated with a scalpel. Curses, souls, and other abnormalities. Such entities exist even within the Ruins. They do not behave like anything that truly lives. I cannot heal them, but I can study them.

quests.title: Whispers of the Past
quests.text: While investigating the Ruins, I discovered some troubling clues. We must determine what happened there if we are to gain a clear understanding of what we are dealing with.

quests.title: Prepared For The Unexpected
quests.text: Surgery is a delicate art that requires the proper tools and precise technique. But in an emergency, even a simple medical kit can be enough to save a life. It would be wise to carry one with you when venturing into dangerous places.

quests.title: Undead Eradication
quests.text: I must admit my curiosity for knowledge gets the best of me at times. I’m interested in the inner workings of a couple particular creatures in the castle. Your assistance in this matter would be greatly appreciated.

quests.title: Doctor's Orders
quests.text: Oh dear, it looks like our medical supplies are running dangerously low. You’ll be able to retrieve more from the crates hidden throughout the dungeons.

quests.title: Frost Aid
quests.text: Leaving an injury untreated can be fatal. I can explain the process, but I recommend learning proper first aid through firsthand practice to improve your chances of survival. Only use a potion if the situation becomes truly dire.

quests.title: Sanctified Healing
quests.text: Even as a man of science, I must admit that the power of the divine has its role. I am however curious as to the limits of the gods. I have a simple experiment I’d like you to undertake for me.

quests.title: Precise as Ice
quests.text: I have a somewhat unusual request. I am quite interested in the anatomy of our giant cousins. If you could bring me some of their toes for research, I would be very grateful.

quests.title: Critical Care
quests.text: I’ve discovered a powerful use for maggots and mold to help heal the body. If you don’t believe me here is what you need to do.

quests.title: Purging Darkness
quests.text: I fear that the forces of darkness grow ever stronger. You must be our beacon of hope and if you should ever be injured in battle, remember what I have taught you.

quests.title: Stone And Bones
quests.text: Alas, I have a final task to ask of you. There’s a door, marked by stone or bones. Beyond this door is an ancient evil who must be vanquished.

quests.title: Verification of Medical Supplies
quests.text: More and more people are using the medical supplies found in the dungeon. I warned them not to use unverified items, but no one seems to listen. Do you think the same way they do? ...Adventurers, honestly. If that’s the case, then at the very least, I want to ensure their safety. Please help me by testing as many of these dungeon-sourced medical supplies as possible and reporting the results.

quests.title: Whose Scream Is It?
quests.text: Strange rumors have been spreading recently. They say screams can be heard throughout the Forgotten Castle. Of course, that place has never been silent—I know that well. However... they claim these are the screams of a woman. Yet, there were no female adventurers present. Could you verify whether this is merely a rumor or something real?

quests.title: The Worth of the Dungeon
quests.text: I am considering ways to repurpose the fabrics recovered from the dungeon. Since many adventurers are already using dungeon-sourced medical supplies without hesitation, I wonder if other materials could also be of use. If I find something suitable, it could help compensate for the shortage of resources. I would appreciate it if you could gather as many different types of fabric as possible.

quests.title: Cutting Edge
quests.text: You’ve arrived. Good to see you still standing. I’ve got a dark muse whispering in my ear and a new creation that demands to be brought to life. I need someone I can rely on for this task. Let’s make sure you haven’t grown lazy and soft like the cushions on my settee. We’re not getting any younger, unfortunately.

quests.title: What Has Been Worn Away
quests.text: Lately, I have been repairing more garments than making new ones, especially those worn by adventurers returning from their journeys. If they are damaged to this extent, the cause cannot be ordinary. If you are willing, could you look into it for me? Should you encounter anything dangerous, please take care and bring back anything that might serve as a clue.

quests.title: Blood in the Ruins
quests.text: I looked further into the people returning in such a wretched state. Some of them were spotted near the outskirts of the Forgotten Castle. Could you go and see for yourself what is happening there? Whether it is connected to the curse or not, we need to know. If you come across any traces of slaughter or battle, bring back whatever you can.

quests.title: Beasts of Burden
quests.text: I’ve worked with fabric all my life, weaving threads into something stronger. But now? Now the threads of this land are fraying, unraveling. These creatures, this cursed wilderness—there’s something far darker at play here, and it’s not just about survival. It’s about control. They’re being manipulated. If we can cut down the monsters and uncover what they’re hiding, we might be able to stop the unraveling.

quests.title: Tailored Wellness
quests.text: Look at you, not quite as tattered as when you first came in, but still showing signs of wear. Don’t ignore it—those ruins don’t just take their toll on your body, they gnaw at your spirit, too. The Shrines of Health should do the trick for now, but you’ve got to keep yourself in one piece if you want to keep moving forward.

quests.title: In Shambles
quests.text: Seeing you in this state takes me back to my own beginnings—digging through trash for scraps, with nothing to my name but hunger and desperation. Let’s gather what’s needed, and I’ll help you craft something that leads to a better tomorrow.

quests.title: Cold Shoulder
quests.text: Frost Mountain offers more than just cold winds and icy peaks. It holds the promise of timeless beauty, its wintry embrace offering a chance to defy the ravages of time.

quests.title: Murmurs Among The Aristocracy
quests.text: Amidst the opulent festivities of high society, I caught wind of troubling news. The rumors of some strange monstrous beasts roaming these lands. You know how most nobility are, don't you? They'll vanish to their countryside estates if we don't address this threat swiftly.

quests.title: Infiltrating With Accessories
quests.text: We have an intriguing assignment today. You will be procuring materials so I can craft accessories as part of a covert operation, designed to deceive one of the dark lords. By gaining their favor, we aim to secure access and gather information.

quests.title: An Uncomfortable Request
quests.text: To win the favor of the upper class, one must know plenty of entertaining stories. Young lords, in particular, are especially fond of tales of adventure. One such curious young master has made a rather troublesome request—he wants someone to slay the monsters of Frost Mountain on his behalf and then recount the adventure to him. What do you think? Are you interested? At the very least, the reward will be generous.

quests.title: Tales of the Frost Mountain Expedition
quests.text: Hmm, it seems your tale was well received. This time, the young lord wants to hear about the fascinating locations in Frost Mountain. There’s only so much I can make up on my own, you know. Since we’ve already started this, why don’t you help me out? Explore Frost Mountain thoroughly and find places that are grand, beautiful, or unique enough to make for a good story.

quests.title: Fantasy and Reality
quests.chapter: Tales of the Frost Mountain Expedition
quests.text: There’s a problem. The young lord enjoyed our stories too much—so much that he now insists on becoming an adventurer! His mother, the lady of the house, is furious! If this keeps up, my connections will be ruined! No, that cannot happen. It’s time to show this naïve young lord a taste of reality.

quests.title: The Cave of Inspiration
quests.text: Frost Mountain truly boasts a breathtaking view. I visited once, long ago, and the Ice Abyss in particular... such mystique, such atmosphere. It stirs the creative fire in artists like myself. Hmm, do you happen to know how to draw? If so, be a dear and sketch different parts of the Ice Abyss for me, will you? I have a feeling they’ll spark some marvelous ideas for a new outfit.

quests.title: The Stylish One’s Survival Strategy
quests.text: Looking at your sketches has only confirmed it for me, I simply must see it with my own eyes. But as much as my stitching is impeccable, I must admit, combat isn't exactly my forte. I know it's dangerous, and I’m not foolish enough to charge in unprepared. So how about this, you go on ahead and deal with the monsters for me. I promise the reward will be well worth your while.

quests.title: How to Use a Wendigo
quests.text: When I visited Frost Mountain, I caught sight of a wendigo in the distance. I used to think all monsters were just hideous brutes, but the wendigo... there’s something different about it. Striking. That peculiar form of its... it might even inspire some patterns or embellishments for a new outfit. Of course, I can’t very well ask you to bring one back alive, so just collect whatever parts you can find. I’ll decide later whether they’re worth using.

quests.title: Is it you?
quests.text: Once, those skeletons were men, brave warriors who swore to protect this kingdom. But the king's hunger for darkness twisted everything. Their souls were bound by a curse, left to wander without rest. There is a prophecy, they say, that a 'chosen one' will break the curse and grant them peace. I once believed I could be that person, but it proved to be a difficult path. Regardless, someone must put an end to this curse. Whether that someone is you or not... there's no harm in trying.

quests.title: A Strange Freshness
quests.text: I hear that food and drink can be found inside the dungeons. Some of it is even said to be edible, so it may be worth looking into. If you find anything like that in a dungeon, would you bring it to me? Just to be safe, don’t try eating any of it yourself.

quests.title: Paper and Ink
quests.text: I seem to have misplaced something important, something more than just paper and ink... a map, to be exact. It once led me to places I preferred to forget, but now I need it. The forgotten castle might still hold the answers, or perhaps more nightmares. Think you can find it in that cursed place?

quests.title: The First Trial
quests.text: Ah, you’ve returned. I paid a visit to our friend, but we’ll need a few things before we can move forward. It’s the first of many trials, if you can call them that. Gather what’s needed, and we’ll see where this leads. If you succeed, we’ll talk about the next step—but let’s not get ahead of ourselves, eh? One thing at a time.

quests.title: Bloody Fingers
quests.text: I’ve got another task for you, and it won’t be easy. The mages will tear through your defenses if you’re not careful. Take them down, and we’ll have one less obstacle standing between us and the truth. Keep your head on straight. This one's going to test your patience.

quests.title: Wenchless
quests.text: Good to see you back in one piece. Things are a mess around here—my wenches have all come down with something, and I’m starting to think it’s not just the roasted rabbit from the other night. In times like this, it’s always smart to have a backup plan. You never know when you’ll need a quick exit.

quests.title: Icy Bastards
quests.text: Word around the tavern is that some frost-bitten creatures have been roaming the outskirts, freezing everything in their path. I’ve got an old friend who might know a way to deal with them, but he needs some muscle first. If you’re willing to brave the cold, I’ll see you’re compensated properly. Just don’t let those icy bastards catch you off guard.

quests.title: Frosty Escapes
quests.text: Now that you've got some experience under your belt, I’ve got a task that’ll put your skills to the test. We need to check the escape routes—make sure they're clear and ready in case things go south. It's cold out there, though, so make sure you bundle up. Last thing I need is for you to catch a chill... or worse.

quests.title: A Giant Problem
quests.text: Ready to face some real danger? We’ve got frost-covered fiends lurking in the shadows of Frost Mountain. A search party’s heading up to look for that missing girl, and they could use some backup. I need you to help clear the way, make sure they’re not walking into a death trap.

quests.title: The Unraveling
quests.text: Something has been shifting in the shadows lately, and I am not the only one who has noticed. The tavern, once brimming with chatter and laughter, is growing quieter by the day. Even my staff have fallen ill with a strange sickness I cannot explain. Some say the darkness is coming from the Forgotten Castle. The brothers have suggested we investigate the matter there. Will you lend us your help?

quests.title: Cursed Connections
quests.text: The situation is growing dire. As they were preparing the body of my deceased staff member for burial, she came back to life! But she was not the same. She attacked anyone who came near, even tearing a chunk out of one of the priests. This... this is the nightmare we are dealing with. We must continue looking into the origins of this curse and find a way to stop it.

quests.title: Dark Advisor
quests.text: We must proceed carefully and find solid evidence before drawing conclusions. The Lich was once the king's most loyal court wizard, and from everything we have uncovered so far, it seems he may have had a much larger role in this than we first suspected. Search the Forgotten Castle and bring back anything that proves his involvement. Only then can we begin to prepare our next move.

quests.title: Blessings Be
quests.text: The fact that you’re still in one piece tells me the god’s are looking out fer ya. Might be a good idea to show your appreciation and offer some blessings at the shrines.

quests.title: Protector's Wrath
quests.text: Would it not be a waste to squander the blessings of the gods within a tavern? I know of some demons who are well deserving of divine retribution. Hunt them down and bring me the proof.

quests.title: Confronting The Darkness
quests.text: The number of monsters within the Forgotten Castle continues to grow. Many adventurers strive to cleanse that place, yet it seems impossible to drive away the darkness entirely... Still, we cannot abandon this fight. Their numbers must be thinned. Defeat them and show me proof of your deeds. It will not be easy, but I ask this of you.

quests.title: Cold-Blooded Conflict
quests.text: The skeleton army has been wreaking havoc up on that snowy peak. Can you get a handle on them before they become an even greater threat?

quests.title: Collector Of Trinkets
quests.text: I owe the Collector a debt but I can’t just leave the tavern. Can you collect the items for me and I’ll make it worth your while.

quests.title: Frozen Terror
quests.text: Demonic forces have made their abode deep within the heart of the frost mountain. To top it off they’ve captured a terrifying frost wyvern. Who knows that terrible plans they intend to use that beast for. We need to take them out before they can spring into action.

quests.title: No End in Sight
quests.text: The lower reaches of the Forgotten Castle have already become a den of demons. The trouble is, their numbers are not thinning but growing still. If this keeps on, they will start crawling upward soon enough. We need to act before that happens. There is no need to go too deep. Just start thinning out the ones in plain sight.

quests.title: A Different Kind
quests.text: I have heard rumors of a creature unlike the common run of demons. The details are still uncertain, but one thing is clear. It is a far harsher foe than any you have faced so far. While the demons we have seen until now were little more than raging beasts, this creature operates with malicious purpose. Judge with care, and do not overreach.

quests.title: The One in Command
quests.text: There is one that commands the demons. You might call it the one that governs the Inferno. Many adventurers have tried to slay the odious overseer, but all have failed. In the past, I would not have sat idle upon hearing this. But I am no longer in a body that can answer such a call. So I would entrust this to the one I trust most. Adventurer, I ask this of you.

quests.title: The Demons Below
quests.text: More demons have appeared deep within the Forgotten Castle. And we still don’t even know what’s causing the plague. Things aren't looking good. If this keeps up, something far worse could be waiting for us. Adventurer, please. Put an end to those demons from the Inferno.

quests.title: A Simple Test
quests.text: Welcome. If you are looking for information or companions, you have come to the right place. This is where adventurers and rumors tend to gather. But information often comes with danger. I do not give work to just anyone. If you want a contract, show me what you can do.

quests.title: Worth Taking
quests.text: There are more useful items in a dungeon than you might expect. Some can be obtained without having to fight every monster. If I were to offer one piece of advice, do not pass by the small chests. Take a closer look, and you may find something better than you expected.

quests.title: What Matters Most
quests.text: As you know, dungeons are dangerous places. With a bit of luck, you might find valuable items or gear. But none of it matters unless you make it back alive. Adventurer, explore the dungeon and return safely.

quests.title: Frostbitten Pursuit
quests.text: As always, I’m after something valuable, but this land is plagued with these beasts—Frost Wolves. I need you to thin them out, clear the path, so I can get what I’m after without being interrupted by these vile creatures.

quests.title: Collector’s List
quests.text: I have quite a long list of curious items I’m pursuing, but we’ll start with these. They may not seem like much on their own, but I assure you, they will help complete my collection. Once you bring them to me, I’ll entrust you with the next request.

quests.title: The Ordinary and the Extraordinary
quests.text: Objects found within dungeons may seem common, yet they are never truly ordinary. At times, the essence of the land or its creatures seeps into them, transforming them into something entirely different. Of course, most may be discarded, but if even the slightest possibility lies within... is that not worth the attempt?

quests.title: Fortune’s Favor
quests.text: I received a request from the Fortune Teller, but of course she asked for an item I passed on to another collector not long ago. I have a few favors to ask of her myself, and I would rather not lose her goodwill over something so trivial. I will need to acquire it again. Would you help me? It should not be too difficult to find.

quests.title: The Unfrozen River
quests.text: Did you know there is a river within the Frost Mountain that never freezes? Stranger still, rafts of unknown origin are said to drift along its waters from time to time. Would you take a look around the Ice Cavern and see if there are any other curious phenomena like this?

quests.title: Peculiar Collections
quests.text: You may not know it, but I place a fair amount of trust in you. I believe that, no matter how strange an item I ask for, you would see it done. This request is no different. It is no different from the tasks I have asked of you before. Now then, would you bring me a few items?

quests.title: Glacial Conquest
quests.text: I apologize for being so terse. I get a little antsy when working on my secret projects. Anyways, I have another task that can lead to riches. Start off by eradicating the undead in the mountains.

quests.title: Chilled Vengeance
quests.text: Been getting reports of some terrible beasts up on the mountain harassing my kin. Can you do a favor and take them out?

quests.title: Morbid Souvenirs
quests.text: What I’d give to have a trophy of those ferocious beasts up on the mountains. Get me what I need and I’ll make it worthwhile.

quests.title: Keeping Warm
quests.text: Heard it’s getting pretty cold up in the peaks. Nothing warms the body like a few good ales and taking out skeletons.

quests.title: Beast of Frost Mountain
quests.text: This time, the task will be a bit more difficult. The yetis of Frost Mountain resemble apes, but they are far larger. Despite their massive size, they are incredibly swift and cunning. If you can bring that creature down, I’ll be willing to consider a new offer.

quests.title: Mountain's Inhabitants
quests.text: I got another peculiar request. I need a few items that only come from the terrible creatures up on that frost mountain. Get them for me and I’ll be sure to make up for your time.

quests.title: Gold-Cloaked Secrets
quests.text: I’ve heard on good authority that some old relics are more than what they seem. If there’s one thing I can’t resist, it’s a good mystery.

quests.title: Fable or Fact
quests.text: Those pieces you brought were just the tip of the iceberg. It looks like the rarer relics hold similar secrets. Can you check some of the more valuable chests for similar relics?

quests.title: Silent Observer
quests.text: I know this next list of items is a little strange, but trust me, I’m getting close to discovering the secret of the relics.

quests.title: One More for the Collection
quests.text: Molten Bats are a common sight throughout Firedeep. Yet when I looked through my collection, I realized I did not have a single item related to them. The more I think about it, the more regrettable that seems. Hunt them down and bring me something to remember them by.

quests.title: The Secret of the Croak
quests.text: I have heard that the toads living in Firedeep produce loud and peculiar calls. Some adventurers even complain that the noise keeps them from getting any proper rest. I cannot help but wonder if there is something unusual about their anatomy. Hunt down the Blaze Toads and bring me a few of their vocal sacs.

quests.title: Between Scales and Shells
quests.text: Much about the creatures that inhabit Firedeep remains unknown. Among them, the relationship between Emberwings and Fire Lizards is particularly fascinating. From what I have heard from adventurers, opinions differ on which of the two preys on the other. I would appreciate it if you could investigate the matter for me.

quests.title: Unusual Find
quests.text: Thanks to the efforts of many adventurers, items tied to demons have become rather easy to obtain of late. As a result, much has already been studied. Such things do not interest me. I seek what no one truly knows, what has yet to be properly understood. An adventurer like you should be able to find such things, would you not? I will see that you are well rewarded.

quests.title: Not of Our Forge
quests.text: Those who have ventured into the lower reaches of the Forgotten Castle all speak of its foul air. Yet within it, the demons move unharmed, even wielding gear not unlike our own. I wonder what sets their equipment apart from ours. Would you bring me something they used? It need not be intact.

quests.title: Beyond Ordinary
quests.text: Wings are usually seen as little more than a bodily organ. Yet in the world of demons, it is said they carry a different meaning. Not merely for movement, but a display of the power they wield and the rank they hold. If that is true, would not the wings of a stronger demon bear something... distinct?

quests.title: The Collector’s Desire
quests.text: Adventurer, there are many like me who seek rare and elusive relics. Such a pursuit is no mere pastime, but a noble path of inquiry. Ancient legends, hidden treasures, remnants of the past, traces of monsters... anything will do. Bring me what is truly rare, and you shall be handsomely rewarded.

quests.title: Buried Secrets
quests.text: Rumors suggest that the bodies within may have been among the first to be subjected to the same ritualistic torment as those more recent poor souls. Search for any clues—check if their tongues were severed or if strange markings are carved into their flesh. We can’t be sure until we investigate. If there’s any connection, we need to understand it before this spreads further.

quests.title: Easing the Burden
quests.text: When I think of those poor souls and their families, left to bear the weight of debts they never agreed to, my heart grows heavy. It is a cruel irony that the dead leave behind not only sorrow but financial ruin. I wish to help free them, but to do so we must gather the necessary funds. Bring me some silver coins, and we can begin to ease their suffering.

quests.title: Misplaced Muffin
quests.text: Nice to see you again. The families are starting to feel the weight lift, and I’m hoping there’s something of real value hidden inside those Mimics. Whatever we find could go a long way in easing their suffering.

quests.title: A Legacy of Pain
quests.text: Greetings. I have been kept busy lately, tending to the belongings of adventurers who passed through the tavern and never returned. It is a task that never gets easier, no matter how much time goes by. What troubles me more is that there are those who seek vengeance for these poor souls. Would you slay the monsters in the dungeons, Adventurer?

quests.title: Wagers and Favors
quests.text: The Collector lost badly in a wager with the Goblin Merchant, and now the debt has fallen to me. I suppose that is the price of an old favor I once owed him. To settle it, I’ll need a few valuables. Bring them to me, and I promise a reward worthy of your effort.

quests.title: Whispers of the Devoured
quests.text: You’re back. Good. I’ve been mulling over something—rumors of creatures that devour souls. The wraiths are the first of many, I suspect. If we slay them, perhaps the souls trapped in this cycle will find rest. And if we’re lucky, those still living might snap out of whatever trance they’re in. It’s a long shot, but it’s a start.

quests.title: Ceremonial Cup
quests.text: I’ve heard whispers—dark rumors—of a chalice, one used in the first rituals. It’s said to lie hidden in the Forgotten Castle, a relic of blood and shadows. I don’t need to tell you that it’s no ordinary artifact. It’s something far darker. Something that could give us the answers we desperately seek, or drag us deeper into this abyss. I need you to find it before it’s too late. The darkness is spreading, and we need to understand what secrets it holds before they consume us all.

quests.title: Clearing the Way
quests.text: I have been informed that there were other items used in the original ritual besides the chalice. My contact is still digging deeper, but some of the missing items may be somewhere within the Crypt. Take a look in the Crypt and see if you can find anything suspicious.

quests.title: Castle of the Forsaken
quests.text: There is one more thing we must uncover. According to my contact's investigation, there is a possibility that traces of the ritual remain throughout the Forgotten Castle. Go and see for yourself if anything lies hidden within the Ruins. Do not overlook any strange markings, symbols, or relics you may find. Every detail could prove to be a vital clue.

quests.title: Iron Tight
quests.text: Deep below The Forgotten Castle lies an iron door sealed shut. It is known to be heavily guarded... but the reason why is still unknown. I need you to go find out what that reason might be.

quests.title: Something Marvelous
quests.text: Rumors of a grand chest filled with blessed riches have echoed around these parts for years... but after hearing some tavern talk, I am convinced I know where it sits. If you think you have what it takes, I will guide you on your way to open it once and for all!

quests.title: A Legendary Addition
quests.text: It seems you have proven your ability to explore the more dangerous parts of that castle. Now I must seek an item once used in a ritual. However, its quality and condition must be excellent. The deeper you go, the easier it will be to find such a thing.

quests.title: Gold Rush
quests.text: As you prepare for the battles ahead, remember this. It is not only your weapons and armor that need strengthening, but your coffers as well! The unexpected is always part of any adventure. Having a little extra coin on hand will put your mind at ease when that time comes.

quests.title: Behind The Stone
quests.text: I have heard stories of a stone door deep below The Forgotten Castle... It is said to hold unimaginable legendary treasures, so, how does a hunt sound?

quests.title: Bangle Lord
quests.text: Recently, more people have been searching for bangles of exceptional quality. Do you happen to know where such things might be found? If fortune favors you, you may find them among the piles of treasure in that haunted castle. But be careful. You will not be the only one searching for them.

quests.title: Superior Equipment
quests.text: What do you believe ensures safety in an adventure? Skill, of course, is essential. But when skill levels are equal, what makes the difference? Superior equipment. Unfortunately, while decent gear is easy to find here, truly exceptional equipment is rare. In truth, many such treasures lie buried deep within the Forgotten Castle, hidden among hoards of riches. You should seek them out.

quests.title: What the Alchemist Seeks
quests.text: Do you remember the stone door you opened last time? Now that we know for certain that treasures lie beyond that door, we must investigate the rumors about another door as well. Open the golden door and see what lies beyond. And... if you come across any treasure that carries a strange aura, be sure to let me know.

quests.title: The Ominous Crown
quests.text: I’ve discovered what the Alchemist is searching for—a cursed crown. No matter what is done to it, it remains unscathed, and the gemstone at its center glows even in complete darkness. Can you find it before he does? I do not know what curse it carries, but this time, the Alchemist must not be allowed to obtain it. I have a bad feeling about this.

quests.title: Culling For Love
quests.text: The season of love has come... yet the air is still filled with death. Skeletons, goblins, kobolds... the plague is spreading to everything that moves. For now, ending those who carry it seems to be the only way to slow its spread. I sincerely ask for your help.

quests.title: Leading The Charge
quests.text: Even the strongest creatures are not immune to this plague. Many adventurers avoid the riskiest encounters, but someone must face them. If you lead the way, I will make sure the risk is worth it.

quests.title: Plague Watch
quests.text: I have yet to measure the true extent of this rot. Search everywhere you can. We must continue to monitor the situation.

quests.title: The First Step of Love
quests.text: The Black Rose has become a symbol of resistance against this plague. Once steeped in darkness, it has now been fully purified, bearing a new kind of beauty and fragrance. Bring me one, and I will reward you for your effort.

quests.title: Going All In
quests.text: You are clearly making a difference, Adventurer. As more people join you in purpose, we will be able to overcome this trial all the sooner. As a token of that journey, would you bring me three Black Roses?

quests.title: Bringer of Love
quests.text: There is no defeat for the power of love. If you can gather ten Black Roses, that alone will stand as a great sign of encouragement in this arduous fight. It may take time, but I ask that you see it through to the very end.

quests.title: Tombstone
quests.text: Stone tombs, and coffins... The Forgotten Castle has an abundance of them... I bet some of them have never even been opened, but you might have to fight to be the first. What do you say?

quests.title: The Statues Are Alive
quests.text: Some fool came into the Tavern last night speaking of “Living Statues” flying around the Ruins... I haven’t ever seen such a thing, but would you mind taking a look?

quests.title: Forbidden Craft
quests.text: My great-grandfather was a master craftsman. Long ago he learned the forging techniques of the dwarves, but that knowledge led him down the wrong path. Using forbidden methods, he forged enchanted daggers and paid a heavy price. I intend to set right the mistakes of the past and forge a weapon that surpasses them through honest skill. For now, bring me a few fine weapons. Examining them will be the first step.

quests.title: Tales of Power
quests.text: Let me tell you more. My great-grandfather once ventured into Frost Mountain, drawn by tales of a sword of great power. It was said to be forged by the same Dwarves who taught him their craft. If this sword is real, it could be the key to completing his legacy—and mine. Find it, and I’ll finally understand what he couldn’t.

quests.title: Farm It or Buy It
quests.text: I am in urgent need of Copper Ore. I am not sure how you will obtain it, but if you do, I will make it worth your while!

quests.title: Growing Whispers
quests.text: Those spiders are not mere creatures. They are part of the curse that has followed my family for generations. My great-grandfather fought them as well and nearly lost his life in the process. If you could slay those wretched spiders, I would be able to study the sword in peace. I would be grateful for your help.

quests.title: In Search of the Dwarven Land
quests.text: I never imagined the dwarves’ ancient homeland would lie beneath the mountain range, connected to the Goblin Caves. There was a reason we could not find even the slightest trace, no matter how thoroughly we searched Frost Mountain. At last, we can investigate the proper place. Adventurer, please confirm the dwarves’ land.

quests.title: The Potential of Obsidian
quests.chapter: In Search of the Dwarven Land
quests.text: Obsidian is so rare that it is usually traded only as expensive jewelry. But weapons forged from obsidian are said to be sharper than those made from any other material. If you can bring me a small amount of obsidian, I will try forging one myself.

quests.title: What the Dwarves Made
quests.text: My great-grandfather even learned his craft from the dwarves, yet now we cannot communicate with them at all... If that is the case, conflict seems inevitable. If I cannot ask them directly, then I would like to examine the tools they have made instead. Their condition does not matter, so please bring me as many as you can.

quests.title: A Lot of Pots
quests.text: That castle is filled with old pots, I once found a legendary Falchion inside one. Why not shatter a few and see what fortune awaits? It’s tradition around these parts.

quests.title: Something Good In Something Small
quests.text: Those pots might not have held what you’re looking for... but surely the chests scattered throughout the castle grounds will. Why don’t you open up a few and report back what you find?

quests.title: Golden Dreams
quests.text: If you are willing to push the limits of your safety, I can make it worth your time! I just need you to open a few Golden Chests, they are plentiful inside The Forgotten Castle. By the way, you’ll need to bring lockpicks to open those chests!

quests.title: Culling the Enemy
quests.text: Good timing. Unfortunately, we’ll have to put our side mission on hold. A surge in monsters is wreaking havoc, and I’m almost certain it’s tied to what we were investigating. It feels like something doesn’t want us getting any closer. Even my trade routes are overrun by these beasts, so the sooner you help me clear them out, the sooner we can get back on track.

quests.title: Gathering Progress
quests.text: Remember that list I mentioned earlier with the glowing bug parts? There are a few more items we need to gather: some rotten fluids, high quality weapons, and ten armor scraps. It’s not a pleasant task, but I know you can handle it.

quests.title: Piercing Heat
quests.text: I have been racking my brain lately, trying to forge a weapon with greater power. Yet with the materials I possess, I cannot bring my idea to life. There are a few things I require, rare and not easily found. Will you help me?

quests.title: An Unusual Quench
quests.text: I have recently been testing a new quenching method using viscous materials. The properties of metal can change greatly depending on the materials used. I hear the creatures of Firedeep yield some promising materials. I would appreciate it if you could bring me some samples.

quests.title: Lessons of the Dwarves
quests.text: Dwarven sites often contain clues to the craftsmanship of their builders. There is much to learn simply by studying the structures themselves or the way the stone was worked. I am curious whether any such signs remain in these newly discovered places. Take a look around and tell me what you find.

quests.title: Materials for Greatness
quests.text: A Magma Wyvern is no ordinary wyvern. There must be a reason such a creature can survive within molten lava. If that resilience could somehow be forged into a weapon, the results might prove quite interesting. Bring me whatever materials you can obtain from the Magma Wyvern.

quests.title: A Weapon That Pierces All
quests.text: Adventurer, bring me a few weapons that are not easily found. My goal is to forge a blade that can pierce through anything. Though I am still far from completing such a work, I refuse to give up and continue my attempts. This time I intend to test materials that are dangerous to handle. I must study them closely and discover how they might be used.

quests.title: The Vile Ones
quests.text: I’ve heard rumors that new demons have begun to appear in the Inferno. They’re stronger, and they hunt adventurers with ruthless precision. It would be ideal to drive them back into the darkness before they fully settle in... but at the very least, we can’t just let them grow comfortable. Take them down. I believe if anyone can do it, it’s you.

quests.title: Out of the Dark
quests.text: The masters of the dungeon have grown more cunning. Those beasts have slithered into deeper shadows than ever before. Facing them will be dangerous, but we have nowhere left to retreat. Adventurer, please put an end to them.

quests.title: Teachings of Arms
quests.text: You cannot hope to forge a fine weapon by relying on luck. It takes constant practice, much experience, and even failure to shape something greater. Studying weapons already completed is of great value as well. If you bring me a few good ones, I shall exchange them for a better piece of my own making.

quests.title: Refinement of Craft
quests.text: Forging ordinary weapons is not particularly difficult. But producing an exceptional weapon is an entirely different matter. The strength and balance a fine weapon must possess can never be fully learned by study alone. So if you bring me weapons that are a step above the last batch, I will use them as the basis to craft an even finer piece.

quests.title: The Craftsman’s Fruit
quests.text: Adventurer, the time has come to take on a new tier. Drawing on the experience I have amassed, I intend to forge a weapon surpassing anything I have made so far. To complete it properly I require your aid. If you would procure for me several rare weapons not easily obtained, I shall present to you the fruit of my labour.

quests.title: Invasive Species
quests.text: A lot of people are helping in the search for the Leathersmith's lost daughter, but not all of them are as capable as you. There’s plenty of inexperienced souls stumbling into the wilderness, thinking they can handle it. It’s up to us to clear the path and make it safer for those who don't have the skills. We don’t want them getting in the way or becoming another burden.

quests.title: Fortune's Guidance
quests.text: Glad to see you made it back in one piece. The search for the Leathersmith’s daughter has turned up nothing, but I’ve been digging around... got desperate enough to visit that damn fortune teller. She gave me a few places to check. Let's see if there's any truth to her cryptic ramblings.

quests.title: The Basics
quests.text: People think it’s the beasts that get you in this land, but it’s not. It’s the cold. The hunger. It gets into your skin, your bones, and slowly, you’re dead before you even know it. I’ve seen too many inexperienced fools wander into the wilderness, too proud to listen to warnings, and they end up like the others. No one dies in their sleep out here unless they’re already dead. If you’re not careful, hunger and frost will do their work long before the claws of any creature ever get the chance. So it’s important to always cover your basics before any adventure.

quests.title: Vexfly
quests.text: The insects of the Forgotten Castle are truly a nuisance. The giant dragonflies in particular spit venom at their targets and follow them relentlessly, constantly hindering their movement. We must deal with these filthy pests before they spread any further.

quests.title: The Use of a Forgotten Castle
quests.text: The cursed castle is full of terrible things, but it sits in a forest long left untouched where good timber can still be found. Sometimes I go there to cut wood and salvage usable pieces from broken remains. If you go to the castle and find good timber, could you bring some back for me?

quests.title: Amidst Peril
quests.chapter: The Use of a Forgotten Castle
quests.text: That forsaken castle has become the final resting ground for too many overconfident adventurers. I’m not saying you’re the same as the rest but I’d be surprised if you could survive more than once.

quests.title: Ember's Amidst Frost
quests.text: Nothing better to test your fire making skills in the most inhospitable environment known to man. Get to it! Practice makes perfect.

quests.title: Frostborn Beasts
quests.text: Something has gotten into the beasts on the frozen peaks. They have been exhibiting more aggression than before. It’s time to put an end to their menace.

quests.title: Frostbound Carnage
quests.text: The giant folk have been making trouble on the peaks. Clear the way for other adventurers and search parties by showing them who’s boss.

quests.title: Frozen Enigmas
quests.text: I’ve heard that the depths of the Frost Mountain hold a dangerous secret. Can you explore it and let me know what you find?

quests.title: Arctic Invaders
quests.text: It’s time to make those ghastly beasts pay for the chaos they’ve unleashed on the mountains.

quests.title: Collect and Deliver
quests.text: I’ve heard that the frost demons have enlisted even more legendary creatures to do their biddings. Bring me proof of their existence.

quests.title: Haunting Presence
quests.text: I used to have a keen sense to detect demonic auras in my youth. Alas, these days that skill has gone to waste. I am curious if you can replicate my odd abilities.

quests.title: Absolutely Batty
quests.text: Demon bats are the bane of my existence. Every blue moon one of those bastards makes it out of their god forsaken hole and wreaks havoc on my plot. Take care of those cursed beasts for me, would you?

quests.title: Infernal Champions
quests.text: The demonic aura coming from the depths of the castle are so powerful that even my waning abilities can sense them. We need a hero to cleanse the air.

quests.title: A Dire Request
quests.text: Please investigate the sites within the Crypt of the Forgotten Castle where rituals tainted by darkness were once performed. I've heard rumors that if one lingers there for too long, screams can be heard. I need to know if there's any truth to them.

quests.title: Into the Darkness
quests.text: There is something I need to find in the Forgotten Castle. But first, the path must be cleared. Beasts tainted by darkness block the way, and my strength alone is not enough to handle them... Could you eliminate these creatures for me?

quests.title: Ancient Records
quests.text: I searched through every bookshelf in the Ruins, but with my dull senses, I couldn’t find a single thing. This isn’t good... I was promised something in exchange for retrieving those books for the Alchemist, something I must obtain. Could you search for the books in my stead? Please, I’m counting on you.
